question: How does will attain effectuation and thereby bring itself into arising?
premises: A prior will belongs to the agent in the sequence of action.
That will attains the state of being effectuated.
By that same will, the will arises as an operative impulse.
inference: Will functions both as what becomes effectuated and as the means by which operative will comes into being.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tasya may be the agent or a preceding mental state.
plain_english: When that will reaches the state of being carried out, it is by that will that the operative will comes into being.
